title: Police arrests around alleged CHADEMA unlawful gathering in Sambarai Kibosho
reason: The article documents 18 arrests and police allegations, but says detainees were apprehended while going to carry out unlawful acts; it does not establish an executed public protest or 50 simultaneous participants.
notes: Do not interpret arrests as participant count or as proof that a gathering occurred. The LHRC report source is search-only because its large PDF failed to render; no unsupported details from that report are applied.

title: Planned Tanganyika Law Society nationwide march
reason: The planned march was suspended after talks with the Chief Justice before a gathering is reported; the contemporaneous article describes calm in regional branches.
notes: The march was announced to condemn the alleged police assault on a lawyer, but the action did not take place according to the opened TNC report. Police presence outside TLS offices is not counted as a protest.

title: CCM presidential campaign meeting in Mbeya
reason: Election-associated campaign rally requesting support for the incumbent party; not an anti-state protest.
notes: Search-only snippet; it is not used to establish event attendance or protest facts.
